title: adhatoda incana
intro: Adhatoda incana, commonly known as Vasa or Malabar nut, is a medicinal plant native to India and parts of Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including bronchitis, asthma, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda incana include its bronchodilatory and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relax the airways and alleviate symptoms of respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
